summary: Federation Calendar Import feature tested. Backend: 13/13 tests pass (100%). Frontend: Import Calendar page accessible, 4-step wizard works. All CRUD endpoints function correctly.

minor.issue: Returns 520 Cloudflare error for invalid region instead of 500 - not a bug, just external dependency behavior

integration_issues.issue: Preview returns 0 matches when using full society name from dropdown, but backend works with partial match. This is expected behavior as the scraper needs exact or partial name match.

issues: Minor console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'.
